target_customer: Agricultural growers and crop-protection distributors facing resistant pests
problem: Conventional pesticides harm pollinators and beneficial insects and pests evolve resistance to them.
business_model: Product sales of biopesticides (engineered virus-like particles); commercialization details not found

founders.name: Zaky Hassan
education: University of Toronto, Honours BSc Biochemistry; PhD candidate Biochemistry
previous_startups: Founded a non-profit that raised $1M+ in grants (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: Protein biochemist and viral structural biologist; two Nature Communications publications.

founders.name: Min Jin
education: University of Toronto, Honours BSc Biophysics; PhD candidate Biochemistry
founders.background_notes: Viral structural biologist; published in Nature Microbiology and Nature Communications.

technical_complexity.rationale: Designing virus-like particle biopesticides with species-specific targeting, supported by a cryo-EM structure of a honey bee receptor, is research-grade work; regulatory approval for new pesticides adds further difficulty.

defensibility.rationale: Founders have six years of joint structural-biology work and Nature-family publications; novel biologic pesticides require specialized expertise and regulatory registration. Patent status not found.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not yet observable; seed announced October 2026. Corteva appears only because it led a round for a different bioinsecticide company (IBI Ag) in search results.

market_need_then: Pesticide resistance and pollinator harm are the stated problems; investors including Convective Capital funded the company in October 2026. No market-size data was retrieved.
outcome_analysis: Molagri is a Summer 2026 YC company that raised a reported $5.2M seed in October 2026, led by Convective Capital, roughly a month after the batch. Its early success to date rests on deep scientific credentials from the founders and a hard-to-copy technical platform, but product, regulatory and commercial outcomes lie years ahead and cannot be assessed from current sources.
notes: Sources conflict on size: AgFunderNews says $5.8M combined pre-seed and seed (14 Oct 2026); BetaKit says $5.2M USD seed plus about $600K before YC; a trackers page says $1M pre-seed. Pre-seed date not found. Founding year not stated in sources read. Competitors not recorded because none were evidenced.
